description: Defines a static class DirectoryResult with methods to create DirectoryResult instances and a readonly struct DirectoryResult<T> that holds a result of type T and a MembershipVersion, with methods for conditional retrieval.

classes.name: DirectoryResult<T>
classes.description: A generic immutable struct that holds a result of type T and a version, with a method to conditionally retrieve the result based on version matching.

methods.name: FromResult
methods.description: Creates a DirectoryResult with a given result and membership version.

methods.name: RefreshRequired
methods.description: Returns a DirectoryResult indicating a refresh is required, with default result and given version.

methods.name: TryGetResult
methods.description: Attempts to obtain the result if the provided version matches the stored version.
